title: na4h: add ipnet dep + peer_whitelist to Config
description:
## What
Add ipnet crate dependency and peer_whitelist config field.

## Algorithm
1. Add to crates/smtp/Cargo.toml: `ipnet = { version = "2", features = ["serde"] }`
2. Add to Config struct in config.rs: `#[serde(default)] pub peer_whitelist: Vec<IpNet>` (import ipnet::IpNet)
3. Add to Config::validate(): iterate peer_whitelist and verify each entry is valid (they will already be parsed by serde, so this is a belt-and-suspenders check — but also add a clear startup error if the TOML value fails to parse as IpNet via a custom serde error)
4. Add doc comment on the field explaining: "Trusted peer CIDRs. Connections from these IPs bypass DNSBL, FCrDNS, and greylisting. Empty by default. IPv4 and IPv6 CIDRs supported. Invalid CIDR is a fatal startup error."
5. cargo build -p stoa-smtp; cargo clippy -p stoa-smtp -- -D warnings

## Defensive rules
- #[serde(default)] is mandatory — absence of peer_whitelist in TOML must not fail deserialization
- serde will emit a clear error if a CIDR string fails to parse (ipnet FromStr error becomes a serde error); this is sufficient — no need to re-validate in validate()
- Do NOT add peer_whitelist to any test Config struct — the #[serde(default)] means tests use empty vec automatically

## Tests
None for this bead — config parsing is tested in na4h.3
